name: RemoveDuplicates.org
description: Remove duplicate lines from a text list, or duplicate rows from CSV/TSV text such as rows copied from Excel or Google Sheets, and get the cleaned text back with counts. Free hosted Streamable HTTP server, no API key; text is processed in memory for each call and never stored.
author: RemoveDuplicates.org

localizations.name: RemoveDuplicates.org 去重
localizations.description: 删除文本列表中的重复行，或 CSV/TSV 文本（如从 Excel、Google 表格复制的行）中的重复行，返回去重结果和统计。免费托管的 Streamable HTTP 服务器，无需 API Key，输入只在单次调用的内存中处理，不存储。
